price_movement.note: Historical odds are from verified archives; no invented prices

closing_line_value.note: CLV computed from opening to closing line movement; positive CLV indicates beating the close

kalshi_research.liquidity_model: Bounded at $500 max in NFLComp sim, realistic bid/ask 2-5¢, slippage above 100 contracts
kalshi_research.never_invent: Never invent liquidity, fills, prices or executions; never place real orders
kalshi_research.execution_realism: Orderbook depth re-anchored to last verified touch; slippage scales with size; partial fills possible

verification_policy.historical_odds: Never invent historical odds; use verified archives (nflverse) or forward-test
verification_policy.price_availability: Historical execution requires observed side-specific price; generic -110 not evidence
verification_policy.liquidity: Never assume unlimited liquidity; brief price not continuously available
verification_policy.settlement: Settlement only from observed final score; no pseudo-random outcomes for props without player stat
